pages.title: Know When to Stop
pages.text: Use a Clutch to stop and restart a driven output, then reverse a driven output with a Gearshift.

pages.title: Know When to Stop
pages.text: Learn control before letting a factory run unattended.

pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: Use native powered components and a real redstone control. Both changes must occur on functioning kinetic outputs; placing a lever is not the objective.

pages.title: How to use it
pages.text: Clutch interrupts transmission and Gearshift reverses rotation under signal; control actual output rather than counting every lever as a new machine.

pages.title: How to use it
pages.text: Redstone Links pair via two-item frequency; configure transmitter/receiver consistently and respect the profile range.
